clusters.name: Integration

nodes.label: Workspace Setup
nodes.oneLine: Prepare a workspace that supports sustained practice without injury or distraction.
knowHow: set lighting for the dominant hand
nodes.checkpoint: Set up a workspace from scratch in under 3 minutes; an observer can name every tool's location without asking.
nodes.commonFailure: Tool placement copied from a video without adapting for arm length — leads to overreaching fatigue.

nodes.label: Material Selection
nodes.oneLine: Choose the right material for a given job by inspecting grain, weight, and moisture.
knowHow: read grain by feel, not sight
test moisture with the back-of-hand method
nodes.checkpoint: Given five unlabeled samples, correctly identify the grain direction and moisture state of each within 2 minutes.
nodes.commonFailure: Judging by colour alone — dyed stock and aged surfaces mislead the eye.

nodes.label: Core Technique
nodes.oneLine: Execute the fundamental operation with consistent, measurable results.
knowHow: maintain consistent feed rate through variable-density material
adjust angle mid-operation when grain shifts
habits: measure twice before the operation, once after
listen for pitch change as early warning

knowWhy.claim: Feed rate should decrease through knots
knowWhy.because: Knots are denser and generate more heat at standard speed

nodes.checkpoint: Perform the core operation on ten consecutive pieces; all ten meet the ±0.5mm tolerance.
nodes.commonFailure: Overcompensating after a miss — adjusting too far creates an oscillation that widens rather than narrows the error.

nodes.label: Capstone Project
nodes.oneLine: Design and execute a complete project from material selection through finishing.
knowHow: draft a cut list from a design
sequence operations to minimise setup changes
habits: photograph each stage for the post-mortem
nodes.checkpoint: Complete a project with at least three joined components; a second practitioner can reproduce it from your notes alone.
nodes.commonFailure: Rushing the finishing stage — the project looks 90% done at assembly and the last 10% gets skipped.
